chapters.caption: The problem
chapters.voice: You send admissions emails, recommendation requests, and marketing outreach — then you wait in the dark. Did they open it? Click the link? View your PDF? MailInsider closes that gap.

chapters.caption: What MailInsider is
chapters.voice: MailInsider is a Gmail-native email client with engagement intelligence. Connect your Google account, compose personal outreach, and see what happened after you hit send.

chapters.caption: Your Sent mailbox
chapters.voice: Your Sent mailbox looks familiar — like Gmail — but every thread can show opens, link clicks, and document views. Admissions, letters of recommendation, and campaign follow-ups live in one place.

chapters.caption: Compose
chapters.voice: Open Compose to write a short, precise message. Attach a PDF, add a tracked link, and keep your full signature clean — without double-pasting or broken formatting.

chapters.caption: AI and RAG
chapters.voice: Here is the AI layer. Describe what you want in plain English, and MailInsider drafts with a local or cloud LLM. Retrieval-augmented generation pulls from your career PDFs and AI profile — so the email reflects your real experience, not generic filler. You always review before send. The AI never auto-sends.

chapters.caption: Send through Gmail
chapters.voice: When you click Send, the message goes through your connected Gmail account. Acceptance is honest — and the conversation returns to your mailbox ready for tracking.

chapters.caption: Opens, links, and files
chapters.voice: Filter by Opened, Links, or Files. Badges appear on the same conversation: opened, link viewed, file viewed. You know who engaged — and when — without leaving the mail UI.

chapters.caption: Reply in-thread
chapters.voice: When they reply, sync brings it into the same thread. Follow up with context — opens, clicks, and document views already on the timeline.

chapters.caption: Send with clarity
chapters.voice: MailInsider. Compose with AI grounded in your documents. Track engagement. Reply in-thread. Built for people who need clarity after send. Try it at mailinsider dot yashjeet dot space.
